_readme: Edit powerhubUrl and propertyCode for this site, then save and restart the bridge.
_howto_find_propertyCode: In PowerHub go to Masters -> Properties. Use the short property CODE shown there (e.g. KDS, MDM). Not case-sensitive.
_propertyCode_note: REQUIRED for multi-property setups. Set to this hotel's property code from PowerHub (e.g. "KDS"). Every relay command lookup is scoped to this property, so the same device number can safely exist at other properties.
